 "floor_ms": 0.61,
 "L_delta": -2.27,
 "rationale": "Both engines use the same covering-index plan. The only frozen work is about 610 page reads (about 0.6 ms), far below T_R_upper of 5.9 ms, so the gap is not architectural. The excess sits in mutable code: start-up (7 ms vs 2.6 ms), the parser/lexer, mimalloc and memcpy. Removing it would need several unproven code changes. I can name no single setting that brings Y under about 8.1 ms, so this stays a candidate."}
